responses.text: {Helped Joe Cobb}Got some fresh grub coming in from Goodsprings.
{Helped Goodsprings}Joe Cobb's crew got themselves killed over in Goodsprings.
{Eddie dead}Who's going to take charge with Eddie out of the picture?
Haven't seen a decent caravan come up the road in days.
Think that rollercoaster in Primm is still working?
If it weren't for Cooke, we'd still be slaving away for the NCR.
{Before Prison Attack}Gotta wonder why the NCR hasn't come for us.
{After Prison Attack}We sure showed those bastards in the NCR.
{Meyers became Sheriff}Haven't seen Meyers around. Did he run off or something?
Scrambler's crazier than usual. Watch yourself.
You hear about the Deathclaws north of here?
Could've sworn I saw some Great Khans the other day.
Steer clear of the Mojave Post. NCR troopers all over the place down there.
